notes.title: アップデート!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/6f3aaa69e2da0e8bf85422963c15d3e4279c57fc.png[/img]

Hello everyone!  
I’ve recently released an update, so I’d like to share the details along with everything added since the last report!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]Lv33 Unlocked[/h3]

　At Lv33, you can now purchase the furniture item “Soft-Serve Ice Cream Maker” from the Traveling Merchant Robot.  
　By placing it, you’ll be able to make soft-serve ice cream.  
　Unlike other manufactured goods, soft-serve cannot be displayed on the standard product racks. Instead, it must be placed on a freezer shelf.  
　Please enjoy making tasty ice cream and serving it to your customers!


[h3]New Products[/h3]
[list]
[*] Frozen Fried Chicken
[*] Chicken Meat

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/4d74b747edeeeae3b7a10b1c2c4f040ad012fdf2.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Other Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased the maximum number of storage racks.
[*] From Lv30 onwards, the “Recommended Campaign” can now be held twice a year, but only when eligible items are available.
[*] Added Lv33 quests.
[*] Added new Steam Achievements.
[*] On clear summer nights, animals will now launch fireworks.  
(From Lv7 and Lv23, you’ll be able to see different types of fireworks.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/33e3dc8c27e186e4cfb3868416beb9b7250d6a1d.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where products could be removed while the “Copy Machine” was inactive.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Milky Moon display overlapped with the Element display in the Traveling Merchant Robot’s shop.
[*] Fixed a bug where purchasing the “Star Sphere” ornament did not increase Energy.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

That’s all for this update!  

I want to thank everyone who reported bugs, streamed gameplay, and shared wonderful screenshots on social media during this period.  

And I especially thank those who left STEAM reviews!  
Reading your warm reviews is a huge encouragement for me in continuing development.  

If you haven’t written a review yet, I’d be truly grateful if you could—it makes me really happy!!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/dd1bd82e8fa78d041acb3382659ba4d7be5791c3.png[/img]

I’ll keep working on updates step by step.  
Please look forward to what’s coming next!

Thank you!

notes.title: STEAM Trading Cards & Point shop items
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/60923ababe94e5c9011c4a0614b12d6a88336422.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

[b]STEAM Trading Cards[/b] and
[b]STEAM Profile Items[/b] have been added to the game Sky End Market!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]STEAM Trading Cards[/h3]

This is one of the platform features provided by STEAM.
They are collectible inventory items on the platform.

They’re not directly related to the main game itself,
so there’s no need to pay much attention to them,
but if you're curious, feel free to collect them.


There are 8 different cards in total.

For every 2 hours of playtime in Sky End Market,
one random card will automatically be added to your STEAM inventory.

You can only obtain cards automatically up to 4 times,
so it’s not possible to collect all of them just by playing.

To collect the full set, you’ll need to use the STEAM Market or trade with friends,
which makes completing the set quite challenging.


If you manage to collect all 8 types, you can craft a badge.
At that time, you’ll randomly receive special Sky End Market-themed emojis or profile backgrounds.

Badges come in 5 levels,
and to upgrade each level, you must complete the full 8-card set again,
so evolving the badge to its final form is extremely difficult.


Also, unrelated to badge evolution, there are so-called rare cards.
I believe they only exist for collection purposes,
but they seem ridiculously hard to obtain.
I have never managed to get one myself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/9fae920f35af74ae065e844e6d0ab6cd42778045.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h3]STEAM Profile Items[/h3]

If collecting cards seems too difficult but you still want profile items,
STEAM now offers a Point Shop system.

There, you can purchase profile items using STEAM Points,
without needing to collect trading cards.
(Some items are only available through the Point Shop.)


For Sky End Market, we've prepared several profile items,
so if you're interested, please check them out.

Visit the Point Shop here:
↓
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/3308550]https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/3308550[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/6e663f92cdd6551b20032577506c524d07f7921e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/8bc7bff7fed10fabbeb13dd26855e461e5a8e6ae.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/5970adf8123d2a08f8da95724c9e18c165b0eade.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/f4698263f32796bd108359fbf6afc914f29de720.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
That’s all for this announcement.
Thank you!

Hello everyone!
This week, I've made several updates, and I'm excited to share them with you!

[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/e96035715b46c71785289e700b2e607862212f5e.gif[/img]

At last, you can now hire part-time workers!
By purchasing and placing a "Part-Time Job Board," you can have part-time workers assist in your store.
If you set up a "Storage Rack" in advance and store boxes of products there,
your part-time workers will restock the shelves for you.
(The "Part-Time Job Board" can be purchased from the Traveling Robot at Level 18.)

The Storage Rack is a facility for storing cardboard boxes.

[list]
[*] Added two new music tracks.
[*] Expanded shop premises.
[*] Added bag skills for special bags.
[*] Separated the vending machine item license tree.
[*] Increased the maximum purchase limit for Frozen BOX by +1.
[*] Changed so that decorative items can no longer be placed on the right side of the cash register.
(To prevent customers' products from becoming invisible at times, causing misunderstanding that the game is stuck.)

[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where gathering quests counted sales of gathered items.
[*] Fixed a bug where the effects of some wall furniture, such as cat posters, were not being applied.
[*] Fixed a bug where products would spill over the register counter when customers bought in large quantities.
[*] Fixed a bug where the price input during Acorn payment was skipped when pressing the space bar.
[*] Fixed a bug where the enter key remained pressed during Acorn payments.
[*] Fixed a bug where some additional bag skills had no effect.
[*] Fixed a bug where the amount for category items in deliveries was incorrect.
[*] Fixed a bug where Frozen BOX and vending machines could be infinitely duplicated.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Poh.PT event where he remained scared instead of falling off the cliff.
[*] Fixed a bug where, when cardboard boxes could not be placed in a wide area, the system kept searching indefinitely to the world's edge, potentially causing a freeze. Now it prioritizes finding a viable placement location.
[*] Fixed a bug where gathering quest translations were missing.
[*] Fixed a bug where, if an untouched naturally spawned cardboard box had another box placed on top and the next day arrived, both boxes would disappear.
[*] Fixed a bug where, if a cardboard box mistakenly recognized a non-cardboard object as its parent, it could not be loaded.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

That concludes this week's update.

This week, there were major bugs related to cardboard boxes, but I managed to fix them successfully.
I sincerely appreciate all users who helped!

I also extend my gratitude to everyone who reported bugs and those who streamed videos of the game!


Additionally, I want to thank everyone who has written a STEAM review!

Please look forward to them!
Thank you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/49d0cdc779583e5f8affb51503a1981a72ade165.gif[/img]

[h3]New Products[/h3]
[list]
[*] Soda (Can)
[*] Green Tea (Can)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/794d0a29d24a485b95209aa909bf8f49dd9bc2b1.png[/img]
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where customers using the self-checkout would panic if the day ended, leaving items stuck in the register.
[*] Fixed a bug where fruit barrels and vegetable baskets would open a portal to another dimension and multiply infinitely.
[*] Fixed a bug where an overwhelming number of grid cells appeared on the screen due to passionate user enthusiasm.
[*] Fixed a bug where settings in the OPTION menu were not being saved.
[*] Fixed a bug where delivery rewards were incorrect.
[*] Fixed a bug where expanding the freezer box caused items to clip through the bottom.
[*] Fixed a bug where the purchase counter light would disappear after repeated achievements.
[*] Fixed a bug where a large tree growing above the store prevented the first shelf from being placed.
[*] Fixed incorrect values in "Your Records."
[*] Fixed a bug where certain NPCs could not be clicked during delivery.
[*] Fixed a bug where decorative items purchased from the traveling merchant robot displayed incorrect elements.
[*] Fixed a bug where some NPCs had unintended hitboxes.
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing ESC to close the menu made the game unresponsive.
[*] Fixed a bug where the dash cooldown bar did not display correctly at the start of the morning.
[*] Fixed a bug where the number of visitors in the daily results was incorrect.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could purchase furniture beyond the available stock.
[*] Fixed a bug where changing BGM volume in the OPTION menu did not immediately apply to the currently playing music.
[*] Fixed an issue with the placement range of the 3-tier S-size rack.
[/list]
[h3]Other Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased the expansion range of the freezer box display skill from 8→10→12.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

That concludes this week's main updates.


It has already been a week since the release.
I am truly grateful for all the players who have been enjoying the game since launch!

Thank you to everyone playing and supporting us!

A special thanks to those who have streamed the game and reported bugs!


Lastly, I would like to sincerely thank everyone who has written a STEAM review!
Reading your warm reviews gives us great motivation to continue development!

If you haven't written a review yet, I would be absolutely thrilled if you could!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/dd1bd82e8fa78d041acb3382659ba4d7be5791c3.png[/img]


I will continue to release various updates.
Please look forward to them!

notes.title: On Sale Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281901/07c99da9fe6edf6889c9cd352a509ca255ab806e.png[/img]

Hello everyone!
[h3]Finally, the game "Sky End Market" has been released![/h3]

I am so excited to bring this game to you!


This game is about running a supermarket.

The setting is... 
the last island on Earth, just before humanity’s extinction.

Here, you will open a supermarket for the remaining humans, animals, and robots.

Your supermarket will definitely be a great help to them!!!

I made this game with the desire to create something fun, like when we used to play store with paper money made from milk bottle caps when we were kids.

I hope you enjoy it!

[hr][/hr]

And,
please be sure to leave a [b]STEAM review[/b]!

Even a simple comment like "I played it" or "I installed it" would be greatly appreciated! It would mean a lot to me as encouragement!

[hr][/hr]

Looking ahead, we plan to update the game frequently and add more content.
In fact, for about a month, we plan to update almost every day.
Stay tuned!

Thank you to those who have been eagerly waiting for the game!
